title: 半抬／半转向小满

image_gen_arguments.prompt: Edit only her head, neck and eye direction in image 1. Make a small halfway movement from the current downward working pose toward a child off-screen to her LEFT and SLIGHTLY BELOW her eyes: slightly reduce the downward head pitch and turn a little farther left. Eyes lead left-and-down, never upward. Keep the same gentle slight-open smile. This is an intermediate, not a completed head turn. Keep the complete transparent frame and her identity: round glasses, grey bun, three red hairpin beads. Preserve both hands, fingers, the pod with exactly TWO seated beans, blouse, shoulders, bangle, basin, legs, shoes and every stool corner/foot exactly as image 1. No loose pea, extra object or text.

semantic_acceptance: 确有小幅头颈姿态变化，不仅挪瞳孔；幅度应介于 c04 与 f04。
视线朝画面左方略下，不能仰视左上灯位。
肩、手和两豆持稳；眼镜鼻梁结合正常，三红珠/发髻身份保留。
